PM2.5.standardReference: National Ambient Air Quality Standard (NAAQS) 24h limit
PM2.5.recommendedMitigation: Deploy mobile wet mist dust suppression cannons and suspend earth excavation operations in designated sectors.

PM10.standardReference: Clean Air Act Title 40 CFR Part 50
PM10.recommendedMitigation: Enforce vehicle tire washing, install perimeter barrier screening, and apply aggregate covers to uncovered stockpiles.

NO2.recommendedMitigation: Inspect diesel machinery for exhaust scrubbers and restrict heavy vehicle idling times to max 3 minutes.

SO2.recommendedMitigation: Switch auxiliary generators to low-sulfur ULSD fuel and conduct immediate fuel assay inspection.

pH.ruleTitle: Effluent and Surface Runoff pH Equilibrium
pH.recommendedMitigation: Activate neutralizing injection basins (CO2 dosing or limestone buffer beds) prior to settling pond discharge.

Turbidity.ruleTitle: Sediment and Suspended Solids Turbidity Limit
Turbidity.standardReference: Surface Water Quality Standard Class II
Turbidity.recommendedMitigation: Inspect and replace silt fence geotextiles; add flocculant dosage in sediment retention ponds.

DO.recommendedMitigation: Activate mechanical aerators and oxygenation bubblers across stream receiving zones; halt organic runoff discharges.

Noise_Day.recommendedMitigation: Erect temporary acoustic noise absorption hoarding panels (min 3.5m height) around high-decibel cutting and drilling zones.

Noise_Night.standardReference: Environmental Noise Guidelines for Residential Zones
Noise_Night.recommendedMitigation: Immediately shut down non-essential impact generators, hydraulic pile hammers, and heavy vibratory equipment until daytime hours.
